title: scaled_dot_product_attention does not support PrivateUse1
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

I notice that scaled_dot_product_attention does not support PrivateUse1.

1. PrivateUse1 always return false on is_device_supported
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/8e05749d5cde0b57b6c3fa805a8d201f0c619079/aten/src/ATen/native/transformers/attention.cpp#L730

2. Say for my PrivateUse1 backend, I would always want to dispatch to SDPBackend::overrideable. The only function in native_functions.yaml seems relevant  is _fused_sdp_choice https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/fa919feab6a55ea9104e4ce61d38c3725f5728e6/aten/src/ATen/native/native_functions.yaml#L14960. 

After registering it 
```
TORCH_LIBRARY_IMPL(aten, PrivateUse1, m) {
    m.impl("_fused_sdp_choice", TORCH_FN(_fused_sdp_choice))
}
```
I don't see _fused_sdp_choice_stub calls into my overrides

Is this a bug or I am missing something

### Versions

2.8.0

cc @NmomoN @mengpenghui @fwenguang @cdzhan @1274085042 @PHLens @albanD
